A group of small cascades is spread across the top of Mink Falls, nestled in a forest beside the Trans Canada Highway north of Lake Superior, Ontario. Black and white.

Numerous waterfalls adorn the north western section of the Trans Canada Highway in Ontario along Lake Superior, one of which is the Aguasabon Falls and Gorge. This one is around the small town of Terrace Bay. There are no trails that lead further into the gorge beyond this lookout point, at least none that I could find.
Mink Falls is sort of semi-secluded... it's less than a kilometre from the Trans Canada Highway north of Lake Superior, but there are no signs so it's not obvious that it's there.

Best 24 Images of all time 16 Waterfalls at Watkins Glen State Park We decided to go to Lake Seneca on a whim. Our planning had told us about Watkins Glen State Park so we knew we were going to explore that area a bit. We were so happy that we did. The park is spectacular and there were great opportunities to capture some waterfalls.
The top portion of Mink Falls along the Trans Canada Highway north of Lake Superior is seen nestled in a forest. Black and white.
Numerous waterfalls adorn the north western section of the Trans Canada Highway in Ontario along Lake Superior, one of which is the Aguasabon Falls and Gorge.

Here's another one of my shots from Mink Falls on the north shore of Lake Superior, somewhere around Marathon and Terrace Bay. This one is close to the highway, yet still off the beaten path because it's really not obvious it's there, which helps to keep the area unspoiled.

On a recent journey north towards Thunder Bay, I stopped at a variety of waterfalls, including this one - Mink Falls. If you didn't know it was there, you'd never know it was there. There are no signs, and the trail is so small that it's almost invisible as you drive by at 100kmph. I knew exactly where it was (thanks to Google), and I still passed it and had to turn back.
